title: Event tail scans must be descending, not ascending
answers: Why does eventStore.latest scan in descending order?
How do I avoid racing with GC when reading recent events?
Ascending scan over event metadata skips entries / has gaps
What order should new event-store range scans use?
body: Any scan over the durable event tail (pkg/storage/unified/resource/eventstore.go:latest) must use SortOrderDesc, not ascending. Scanning ascending races CleanupOldEvents (GC), which deletes oldest events first, and can leave gaps in the returned page. Scanning descending is safe under concurrent GC: the worst case is only a shortened tail (missing very old entries), never a gap in the middle. Apply this rule to any new read path added over the same eventsSection KV keyspace.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/eventstore.go and any new scan added over the eventsSection KV keyspace
